excluded_inputs: Family 001 features, target, predictions, decisions and outcomes
Family 002 tensors, labels, models, probabilities, decisions and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunities and component economics
material_distinctions: paired market-relative convergence rather than an outright single-symbol direction
causal closed-form hedge relation and residual displacement rather than supervised return or barrier labels
two-leg spread, minimum-lot and aggregate basket risk economics
convergence, basket-PnL and time exits rather than a fixed single-leg target

decision.when: first executable tick of a common new server H1 bar while no basket is open
decision.uses: only common H1 bars completed strictly before the decision
decision.capacity_after_exit: next common H1 open after the exit bar

pair_universe.ranking: largest absolute residual z-score, then declared pair order

causal_relationship.fit: closed-form ordinary least squares of log(first) on intercept plus log(second)
causal_relationship.fit_window: the 960 common completed H1 bars ending at the immediately prior bar
causal_relationship.residual_mean_and_std: population statistics of the last 96 fitted residuals under the current causal alpha and beta
causal_relationship.current_residual: residual of the immediately prior completed H1 close under the same alpha and beta

candidate_bundle.common_rule: while flat, trade the declared pair with largest absolute valid residual z when it meets the role threshold; positive z shorts the first and longs the second, negative z longs the first and shorts the second

atr_and_volume.atr: simple mean true range through the immediately prior completed H1 bar
atr_and_volume.planned_leg_loss: one prior ATR times dollars per price point times volume
atr_and_volume.volume_rounding: floor each leg's one-percent risk volume to 0.01; use 0.01 when below minimum only if the final two-leg planned loss remains within the four-percent basket cap
atr_and_volume.skip: skip the basket if either ATR is invalid, either volume is invalid, combined planned loss exceeds four percent, or larger-to-smaller planned leg risk exceeds 2.5

quote_and_cost.actual_cost: one recorded spread per leg through direction-specific Bid/Ask entry and exit
quote_and_cost.stressed_cost: actual paired path minus one additional decision spread per leg
quote_and_cost.same_bar_joint_extremes: long leg low plus short leg high is adverse; long leg high plus short leg low is favorable

basket_exit.planned_risk_R: sum of both one-ATR planned leg losses at entry
basket_exit.stop_take_observation: conservative joint H1 extremes with adverse same-bar ordering; threshold execution is used absent tick ordering
basket_exit.convergence_exit: at a completed H1 close, the frozen entry alpha/beta residual crosses its entry residual mean
basket_exit.time_exit: close both legs at the third bar close if no earlier stop, take or convergence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net

ordered_stages: byte-equal input materialization and complete adapter implementation freeze with structural pair-density only
one complete 2024-2025 three-role paired economic process
locked 2026 confirmation for at most one unchanged survivor
self-contained EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5; do not rescue an adjacent z threshold, pair, hedge window, fit gate, stop, take, convergence or hold
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
